subject: Code review: Changes requested for AMSD-2041

body.text: Code review identified issues that need to be addressed.

issues.description: No unit tests were added for the new live_preview configuration. The existing test file already tests the analogous conditional-spread pattern for CONTENTSTACK_FETCH_TIMEOUT (two tests: one verifying options include fetchOptions when the env var is set, one verifying it's absent when the env var is missing). The new live_preview config follows the same pattern but has zero test coverage — no test verifies that options.live_preview is populated when CONTENTSTACK_PREVIEW_HOST is set, nor that it's absent when the env var is missing.
issues.suggestedFix: Add two test cases mirroring the existing CONTENTSTACK_FETCH_TIMEOUT tests: (1) set CONTENTSTACK_PREVIEW_HOST and CONTENTSTACK_PREVIEW_TOKEN, require the module, and assert options.live_preview equals { enable: true, host: <value>, management_token: <value> }; (2) leave CONTENTSTACK_PREVIEW_HOST unset and assert options does not contain live_preview.
